correction_scope: Versioned semantic and accounting correction for the inherited v0.17 baseline locator of Digital Edge CGK Campus (CGK1). The selected OSM polygon is the whole GIIC host estate; it was labelled and counted as a campus locator and it wholly contains another selected campus. The numeric polygon, display anchor, raw capture hash, physical site, project, identity and construction observation are unchanged. The entity kind, use scope, method, scope class, precision and uncertainty statements, evidence key and verification posture are corrected to host-estate locality context. No added or removed campus or project, lifecycle refresh, finer location, boundary, precision gain or acceptance claim.

supersedes.correction_reason: The v0.16 seven-country batch turned the operator's locality-only statement (GIIC Industrial Estate, Bekasi; curated method authoritative_locality with null coordinates and geometry) into the whole OSM GIIC estate polygon labelled geometry_use_scope campus_locator. v0.17 and every v0.18 draft therefore count CGK as a reviewed site locator and publish the planar centroid of the estate's longitude/latitude ring as its latitude and longitude. The polygon is about 2,113.63 ha, wholly contains the selected STT Jakarta Data Centre Campus geometry (the only intersecting pair among the thirty-fifth checkpoint's 197 sites) and six named data-centre buildings of five other operators, and no reviewed source places CGK within it.

defect_findings.finding: The selected geometry is the whole GIIC host estate (OSM way 568349989 v13; 458 distinct vertices in a closed way of 459 node references; about 2,113.63 ha WGS84 geodesic; bounding box about 7.84 km by 6.29 km), labelled geometry_use_scope campus_locator. The CGK1 source supports locality only (curated method authoritative_locality, null coordinates and geometry).

Project and site latitude/longitude publish the planar centroid of the estate's longitude/latitude ring (107.18709493651593, -6.386820103966021; the v0.16 record labels it projected_polygon_centroid, but no map projection is applied), an industrial-estate centroid, with spurious precision. Estate vertices lie up to 4.107 km away, and the nearest named data-centre building to it is AWS ref CGK Sukamahi at about 977 m.

The polygon wholly contains the selected STT Jakarta Data Centre Campus geometry (vcc-site-57a103a9de718a95ae14, OSM way 1533569836, identical in the 2026-10-08 snapshot). This is the only intersecting pair among all 197 thirty-fifth-checkpoint site geometries.

Six named data-centre buildings of five operators lie inside the polygon: AWS, Princeton Digital, Microsoft (two), Digital Hyperspace and STT. The geometry cannot distinguish CGK from other campuses, and the generic CGK prefix is also used by AWS and BDx.

CGK is counted in reviewed_site_locator_projects (195 at the thirty-fifth checkpoint) with posture recent_authoritative_physical_observation_plus_reviewed_site_locator. No v0.18 location basis admits a host-estate geometry; the v0.18 docstring states that locality centroids are excluded.

The numbers are a faithful copy: canonical geometry 11,415 bytes, sha256 bc2c85e9..., identical to the 2026-10-08 Geofabrik snapshot. OSM node coordinates are WGS84, so this is a scope, selection and accounting error, not a datum or transcription error.

Frozen in v0.17 (projects.csv line 37, sites.csv line 36, evidence.csv line 136, sites.geojson feature 34) and copied byte for byte into every v0.18 draft through the thirty-fifth. The additive v0.18 builder copies baseline CSV bytes and features verbatim and rejects baseline keys and evidence IDs, so no contract rebind can correct it. Helios, by contrast, was an expansion row rebuilt from contract sources.

checkpoint_application.summary: Unlike Helios, this corrects a frozen baseline row, so the checkpoint must first extend the builder. Earlier contracts and drafts stay on schema v1 and remain byte-reproducible.
steps: Commit this file under sources/ and pin its bytes and SHA-256 in reviewed code.

Add contract schema datacenter-atlas-v018-reviewed-batch-v2. It is v1 plus a baseline_corrections array whose entries carry correction_id, physical_site_stable_key, project_stable_key, frozen_rows (v0.17 line numbers and canonical row/feature hashes from supersedes.frozen_baseline_rows), geometry {source_id, record_pointer /results/0, record_sha256}, evidence_source_ids and reason. The v1 schema keeps rejecting the key.

Add ReviewPins.baseline_correction_sha256, an independent pin per correction_id. Validate every frozen-row hash against the pinned v0.17 manifest, and validate supersedes against the frozen v0.16 facts file.

Validate the geometry record with a dedicated baseline-correction validator. It accepts location_basis host_estate_locality_context, entity kind host_estate and use scope host_estate_context only for baseline corrections, never for acceptances. It requires the geometry and anchor to equal the frozen row exactly and accepts the inherited date-only retrieved_at only for the reused frozen capture.

Rewrite only the enumerated fields of the CGK projects/sites rows and feature properties, leaving all other baseline bytes identical. Drop evidence row 8acab3b0-..., add the two correction evidence rows, and add the CGK project to the shared CRS row's project_ids_json.

In core, map geometry_use_scope host_estate_context to posture recent_authoritative_physical_observation_plus_host_estate_context_only; _is_reviewed_locator excludes it. Add counts host_estate_context_projects, add selection-report baseline_corrections and locator_exceptions blocks plus a README sentence, extend schema allowed values, and amend the docstring invariant to cover pinned baseline corrections.

Add exact-delta regression tests modelled on test_expansion_200_third_reviewed. Assert that only the enumerated fields change, that geometry, latitude and longitude are unchanged, that 8acab3b0 is absent and 60324cce and 7133f023 are present, and that the CRS row changes only project_ids_json. Assert reviewed_site_locator_projects falls by one with physical_sites unchanged, that CGK and STT are the only intersecting pair (whitelisted as host-estate context), and that v0.17 and every earlier draft still validate byte for byte.
Add a docs/expansion_200.md section 'Explicit CGK host-estate locator correction' parallel to the Helios one.
checkpoint_application.count_consequence: Physical sites and projects are unchanged; evidence rises by one net row. reviewed_site_locator_projects falls by one, the remaining-addition gap is unchanged, and the correction adds no site.
checkpoint_application.completion_claim_consequence: A 200-site claim must state that one baseline site, CGK, has host-estate locality context only, not a reviewed locator. If a verified-200 claim requires every counted site to have a reviewed locator, CGK cannot satisfy it until an exact locator exists, so one further addition would be needed.
checkpoint_application.future_upgrade_gate: A freely accessible operator-issued CGK numeric point, official parcel or permit geometry binding PT Digital Gayana Ekagrata or CGK, proponent statutory KML, or a named OSM feature for the campus. Apply it through a further versioned correction with full geometry and alias screening.

validation_scope: Inherited geometry decoded and hash-checked against the v0.16 encoding. The ring was compared with the independently checksummed 2026-10-08 Geofabrik snapshot (identical, way v13) and pairwise intersections were recomputed for all 197 thirty-fifth-checkpoint geometries with Shapely 2.1.1. Frozen v0.17 and thirty-fifth rows were hashed and confirmed identical. The geometry record's ring and anchor structure was exercised with the v0.18 _geometry validator under substituted enumerations. The parent owns the builder extension, contract, pins and exact-delta regression tests.
